title: Magnetic field expression
description: Essential: Correctly derives and states the final expression for B = (1/L)√(mgR/(2v₀)).

title: Potential difference U_cd
description: Essential: Correctly derives and states the final expression for U = (3/4)E₀ = (3√(2mgRv₀))/8.

title: Joule heat Q
description: Essential: Correctly derives and states the final expression for Q = mg(d+L)/2 - (3/2)mv₀².

title: Force balance at entry
description: Important: Applies equilibrium condition (mg sinα = BIL) when cd enters and the frame moves at constant velocity v₀.

title: Energy conservation setup
description: Important: Sets up energy balance: mg(d+L)sinα = ΔKE + Q, correctly identifying the change in height and kinetic energy.

title: Velocity at PQ
description: Important: Uses Newton's second law at PQ (BI₁L - mg sinα = m(g/2)) to find v₁ = 2v₀.

title: EMF and Ohm's law
description: Optional: Correctly applies Faraday's law (E = BLv) and Ohm's law (I = E/R) for both entry and PQ positions.

title: Sign error in force
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect sign in force equation at PQ (e.g., adding gravity and magnetic force).

title: Potential difference confusion
description: Pitfall: Treats U_cd as the full induced EMF E₀ instead of the voltage across that side (3E₀/4).

title: Height change mistake
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect height change (e.g., d instead of d+L) in energy conservation.
